    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_full_span_localized_action {k F R B C : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [IsAlgClosed F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Ring B] [Algebra k B] [Ring C] [Algebra F C] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] (P : TwoTerm R) (f : R →ₐ[k] B) (hf : IsUniversalLocalization (fun (x : Unit) => P) f.toRingHom) (g : ExtendedAlgebra k F R →ₐ[F] C) (hg : IsUniversalLocalization (fun (x : Unit) => P.induce (algebraInclusion k F R).toRingHom) g.toRingHom) (X : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)) {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (v : Module.Basis n F ↑X.obj) (hs : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (P.induce (algebraInclusion k F R).toRingHom)).IsStable X) (hi : (P.induce (algebraInclusion k F R).toRingHom).InvertedOn X.obj) :
    ∃ (ρ : B →ₐ[k] Matrix n n F), (∀ (r : R), ρ (f r) = (basedAction v) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧ Submodule.span F (Set.range ⇑ρ) = ⊤

    A stable geometric module inverting the ground differential admits a compatible based action of the ground localization with full geometric span.
